name: chatgpt-codex-bridge
description: Use ChatGPT Pro as the supervisor for local Codex on Windows or macOS through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel.

interface.shortDescription: ChatGPT Pro supervises local Codex through Secure MCP Tunnel.
interface.longDescription: Install, verify, and operate a per-device Windows or macOS bridge where ChatGPT Pro discovers repositories and Codex threads, supervises durable background jobs, reviews structured progress, and continues the same local Codex context.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my Codex tunnel bridge is ready.
Explain how one ChatGPT conversation delegates a long Codex job and receives its result.
